question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**numerous**" fits here because it refers to the large number and variety of courses that students might be engaged in, which have been impacted by the transition to digital training.
 
• "**Fewer**" suggests a smaller number and does not fit the context well as it implies reduction rather than a broad impact.
 
• "**Particular**" limits the scope to specific courses, which does not capture the broader impact described in the passage.
 
• "**Limit**" is not appropriate as it is a noun or verb referring to a boundary or restriction, neither of which fits contextually here.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *As a result of Covid-19, the quick transition to digital training has exposed the hazards of student disengagement and the resulting consequences of lower student performance across numerous__ courses.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fewer (कम)**: refers to a smaller number of things.
 
• **Particular (विशेष)**: specific to an individual case or subject.
 
• **Limit (सीमा)**: a restriction or boundary.
